title: Book One · Chapter 102: Rain on the Lesson Plan
story:
Miss Wu crosses out the river walk on the board.

Outside, rain hits the window in quick white lines. The class makes a disappointed noise. Leo hurried to put on his driest shoes. He put them on the wrong feet.

“We shall stay inside,” Miss Wu says. “We have our first river pictures. Let us compare those pictures and our new results.”

Ronan wants to see the leaves again. Do they still turn near the wall? A picture cannot show him today's leaves.

“Can we go tomorrow?” he asks.

“I cannot promise dry weather tomorrow. I need time to ask the parents to come too. We shall choose another safe day later.”

She has other things to arrange too. One child has a cough. Miss Wu moves his seat away from the open window. A school note must be sent to another class. She asks Ronan and a partner to carry the note. They use the covered passage between the classrooms.

The passage floor is damp. They walk slowly. At the far door, they give the other teacher the note. She asks them to wait. She needs to write a reply to Miss Wu. Ronan watches rain gather at the end of the roof. The drops join as they reach the roof's edge. Then they fall close together in a thin line.

He wants to draw it, but has no paper. His partner offers the back of a spelling scrap. They wait by the door. They draw a roof corner and three rain lines.

Back in class, Miss Wu gives them the first river pages. Ronan finds the dark rail across his drawing. Behind it are two little arrows. One goes round in a circle. The other points along the river.

He remembers both places. He does not remember the colour of the far boat.

Mei checks her page. She wrote TOO FAR. The words are still honest today.

Leo's drawn leaves look very large. The real leaves were much smaller. “I can show the direction with bigger leaves,” Leo says. “That is a close view,” Mei says. “Call it that.”

They draw a small box round the leaf picture. They write CLOSE VIEW above it. Ronan understands this label now. Those two words explain the size in the picture.

The borrowed large basin arrives after lunch. Miss Wu has time for two final tests. The rest will happen next lesson. Ronan and Mei still need to write a sentence. They let Leo's group use the basin first.

Now they have time for their sentence. They finish the sentence. Their turn comes later in the week.

After school, Mum waits by the gate. She has a broad umbrella. Ronan tells her the river walk was crossed out.

“Today it was,” she says.

He shows her the roof picture on the spelling scrap. Their rain lines cross one of the old spelling words.

“You found something closer.”

“It was falling right beside us.”

They walk home slowly. Mum keeps the umbrella tilted away from his collar. His neck needs to stay dry. He carries his folder under his jacket.

At home, a dry mat lies inside the door. Dad put it there. Mrs Lan has a small drip in her front room. Her bowl sits beneath it. The rain made more work for everyone. Mum shows Ronan a dry place for his jacket. He hangs it there. Then he puts his folder on the dry shelf.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- crosses out＝划掉
- covered passage＝有顶走廊
- close view＝近看图
- tilted＝倾斜的

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：cough＝咳嗽；roof＝屋顶；collar＝衣领。

## 读句提示

**They walk slowly.**

他们／慢慢走。上一句先说明地面湿，因果按顺序给出。

## 理解问题

1. MissWu为什么不能随口答应明天去河边？
2. 孩子们怎样说明图中放大的叶子？
